question:
I'm trying to debug a DBT project I've created.

I used to be able to take the compiled\run files from under target folder.

Now for some reason it remains empty after running.

I've tried:

  • Running dbt clean and running again.
  • Removing target-path: "target" from dbt_project.yml (Which shouldn't make a difference as I'm using the default folder).

Yet it doesn't seem to work.

The problem is only for one specific DBT project. Other projects create compiled files as expected.
title: DBT - compiled/run files not created in target-path
answer:
It seems that for dbt 1.5 something has changed regarding the target-path, see here:

"As of dbt version 1.5, setting the target-path in the dbt_project.yml is deprecated. Backward compatibility is still supported in 1.5 but will be removed in a future update. Migrate to the CLI flag or environment variable methods to avoid potential errors or disruptions."

This should not yet have a direct effect.
However, I've also realized that there has been a behavior change within dbt that has a direct effect on the target/ path and is not (as clearly) documented. Namely, the target path will be created in the folder from which you run dbt run / dbt compile. This might diverge from your dbt folder, if you are invoking dbt from a parent folder. For example, I call dbt run --profiles-dir dbt/ --project-dir dbt/ from the root folder of my project. Before, the target folder would be then created under dbt/target/. Now, it is created in the root folder target/. Maybe you are dealing with this?
